verified_facts.text: The Maybourne Beverly Hills is the Maybourne group's first US hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Maybourne is the first US outpost of the storied Maybourne Hotel Group

verified_facts.text: The rooftop pool is on the 9th floor, planted with native trees and flowers, with a Mediterranean beach resort ambiance.
verified_facts.excerpt: With breezy Mediterranean beach resort ambiance, teeming with native trees and blooming flowers, delicate hummingbirds add to the natural atmosphere of our idyllic 9th floor pool.

verified_facts.text: The rooftop pool has poolside chaises and private cabanas, with spritzes, oysters and wood-fired pizzas by Dante.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savor refreshing spritzes, fresh-shucked oysters and authentic wood-fired pizzas by Dante in one of our poolside chaises or private, decked-out cabanas.

verified_facts.text: Suites feature collectible artworks, sumptuous bathrooms and mid-century-inspired furnishings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Collectible artworks, sumptuous bathrooms and luxurious takes on mid-century furnishings

verified_facts.text: Suite experiences range from live pianists to in-suite cocktail experiences and use of BMW i7 sedans to explore LA.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have Dyson hair dryers, Cowshed amenities, 600 thread count linens and floor-to-ceiling windows.

verified_facts.text: The 20,000-square-foot spa includes a riad-style mineral pool, saunas, Turkish steam rooms and Balinese-inspired relaxation rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: The 20,000-square-foot spa is top of the line, and includes a stunning riad-style mineral pool, saunas, Turkish steam rooms, and Balinese inspired relaxation rooms.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers Dr. Barbara Sturm facials, including The Maybourne Sturmglow facial created exclusively for the spa.

verified_facts.text: The Terrace overlooks the lawns of Beverly Canon Gardens, with the feel of a European piazza.
